name: ZCA_SIGNAL_ATTRIBUTES
description: ZCA_SIGNAL_ATTRIBUTES: This table stores the attribute values for a signal definition generated by a Business Object event.

columns.name: SIGNAL_ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table

columns.name: SIGNAL_ID
columns.description: Parent foreign key referring to ZCA_SIGNALS table.

columns.name: ATTR_VALUE_TYPE
columns.description:
Discriminator column to determine whether row is for a single value, or for an "Old and New" value.
'S' (simple) or 'C' (change value)

columns.name: ATTR_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the object or related object to which the attribute value belongs

columns.name: ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Name of attribute this row represents

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether this is a PK attribute

columns.name: PUID_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether this is a PUID attribute

columns.name: ATTR_VALUE
columns.description: Value of attribute this row represents.

columns.name: ATTR_OLD_VALUE
columns.description: Old value of attribute this row represents - only applies to rows where ATTR_VALUE_TYPE = 'C'.

columns.name: PII_TARGET_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Stores the ID of the target PII Entity when the current attribute was generated from an object that is potentially subject to PII visibility rules.

columns.name: PII_CONSTRAINT_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the type of PII constraint to apply when the current attribute was generated from an object that is potentially subject to PII visibility rules.

columns.name: PII_ENTITY_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Stores the Entity Name of the target PII Entity when the current attribute was generated from an object that is potentially subject to PII visibility rules.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
